locator: The lower left of the plate: men and women walking on Fifth Avenue before St. Patrick's Cathedral, from above at about ten to twenty metres.
rights_note: LOC rights advisory: 'No known restrictions on publication.' Used only as a reference picture the 1904 lady is judged against at street distance (T-3447); nothing is traced or sampled from it.
access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (T-3447) from the master TIFF. Easter 1904 on Fifth Avenue: the women walk in long dark coats and skirts to the ground, some with pale shirtwaist fronts, nearly all in wide hats trimmed high with flowers and plumes; at this distance a woman reads as a dark bell from the waist to the ground, a pale collar and face, and a broad hat. New York, not Chicago.
note: The far picture of the 1904 lady reference set (data/people_match/reference_sets/lady_1904.json).
what_it_supplies: how a lady's dark day dress and trimmed hat read on a walking woman at ten metres and more, in 1904
what_it_does_not_supply: the cut of any garment in detail; any named person; no likeness is asserted
